auth-bypass.help: Point philo-fe at its own email-impersonation login (no auth-svc at all)

auth-local.help: Point philo-fe at the LOCAL auth-svc (real OAuth against :8000)

auth-staging.help: Point philo-fe at the STAGING auth-svc (real OAuth; the default)

convert-check.help: Is it safe to switch a service between flat and bare layouts? (read-only)

data.help: Reload philo's sanitized data dump (slow; prompts for aws-vault)

doctor.help: Read-only health check: the machine (bootstrap --check-only), then every service

down.help: Stop + remove every selected service (data volumes preserved; down:philo for one)

init.help: Clone the repos the stack needs, as bare repos with a main worktree

logs.help: Tail logs from every selected service

nuke.help: Stop + remove every selected service AND its volumes (wipes local databases)

preflight.help: Check the irreducible prereqs (aws-vault, ~/.netrc) and fail with guidance

profiles.help: List start-up profiles: what each includes and what's actually available

pull.help: Pull latest main into each checkout, no rebuild (pull:philo for one)

seed.help: Seed a local login into auth-svc (testing@tatari.tv / local-dev-only)

start.help: Start each service in scope, building anything missing (start:philo for one)

status.help: Show container status for every selected service (or -p <profile>)

stop.help: Stop every selected service (containers preserved; stop:philo for one)

switch.help: Point a service's checkout at a branch (detached; prefers origin/<branch>)

up.help: Rebuild each service in scope from current code; prompts for aws-vault (up:philo for one)

use.help: Record a default profile for start/up (-p none clears it)
